Maya (CSM): FYI KiteTech onboarding next Tue. Early QA flagged embed latency variance — p95 ~1.3s but some 2s+ tails when users upload 20MB docs. Concerned about renewal signal if search feels slow. Thinking a proactive perf tweak: compact int8 + region pin + small canary. thoughts?
Ravi (CS Ops): agree we should be proactive. keep it low-touch for chat routes. focus only embed route. notify customer.
Noah (ML Eng): propose: swap /v1/embeddings to redwood-compact-v2-int8 for us-west, leave eu on redwood-base-v1-fp16. enable prefix caching and micro-batching (20ms). Canary: 4% for 2h -> 12% for 8h. auto-eval against kite_embed_smoke.
Priya (Support): add quality checks and rollback thresholds. what metric threshold?
Noah (ML Eng): set auto-rollback if avg cosine drop > 0.012 OR p95 not improved by >= 12% at 12% stage. Also capture 250 sample traces with X-Trace-Sample: true.
Ethan (KiteTech Ops): they hit embed-doc and chat-doc. chat should be untouched. us-west primary, small ap-south traffic. OK to pin us-west.
Ravi (CS Ops): I'll draft customer note explaining slight centroid shift risk for very long docs and recommend reindexing only if they notice drift.
bot-rollout: created ticket KT-7732, channel #kite-perf, scheduled canary Wed 08:00 PT, configured rollback on cosine_drop > 0.012 or p95_gain < 0.12.
Priya (Support): i'll monitor support channel and surface any regressions. Noah, can you add a fallback policy to route to base model for failing requests?
Noah (ML Eng): yep — fallback header X-Fallback-Model: redwood-base-v1-fp16, and keep manual rollback window for 90 minutes after canary start.
Maya (CSM): action list: 1) Noah apply canary + traces, 2) Ravi send customer comms, 3) bot-rollout run canary, 4) Priya monitor. follow-up check 24h after canary completes. thanks :rocket:
